name: cl-company-formation
description: Chile company formation and entity choice for calendar 2026: ordinary SpA, Ltda., closed S.A. and EIRL, founder and capital conditions, the optional Registro de Empresas y Sociedades route, signatures, traditional registration and publication, RUT and the separate SII activity-start handoff. Distinguishes incorporation from tax regime, permits and bank onboarding; includes capital reconciliation and facts needed from foreign founders. Trigger on Chile company formation, constituir empresa, Tu Empresa en un Día, SpA, Ltda., EIRL, Registro de Empresas y Sociedades, RUT empresa and inicio de actividades. Excludes regulated entities, immigration, tax-neutral reorganisations and investment reporting; tax computations belong to the Chile corporate, VAT, payroll and cross-border Guides.
